notes.text: All69 origins with mature paired evidence offered8 legal new Chronos input configurations at the post-diagnostic decision. The3 origins without a mature cohort correctly offered no revision actions. Zero revisions were selected; none were blocked by missing action registration.

All72 initial alternatives use72-hour history:39 base and33 price_only. All16 final alternatives are initial proposals; no forecast is the product of a second input revision. No pool or optional inspect action was selected.

Among69 paired origins,42 have default lower historical QS and27 have initial alternative lower historical QS. The agent matches the two-candidate historical argmin48 times and differs21 times; this is not a forced lowest-QS selector.

Probabilities are typed action preferences, not calibrated forecast accuracy. Lower revision preference than immediate submission is observable; hidden motivations, whether extra computation would be useful, and the accuracy of ungenerated candidates are not established by traces.

Since optional revisions were never executed, any observed score difference from the older R19 run cannot be attributed to actual iterative input revision. The current traces show changed initial proposals, retrieval choices and final decisions; causal attribution among policy/skill/interface changes requires a controlled comparison.

Read-only analysis of this completed72-origin smoke only. No model/API calls, no source or skill modifications, and no access to the separate ongoing daily replay or its labels. Historical diagnostics in traces are already matured observations, not future forecast evaluation.
